c74object.name: evi_hzpitchmodmods
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Modulation helper for filters and oscillators, with additional unprocessed frequency output
c74object.description:
evi_hzpitchmodmods is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_hzpitchmodmods.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_smooth.genexpr
Identical to evi_hzpitchmods but with additional unprocessed frequency output. A curious but useful (and expensive) modulation helper for oscillators and filters requiring FM control of frequency. The main cutoff frequency can be optionally smoothed, scaled, FM-ed with a pitch signal and FM-ed with a Hz signal.

geninlet.name: cutoff
geninlet.digest: in Pitch or Hz. The required cutoff frequency, units depend on the @mode attribute, by default this is in Pitch.

geninlet.name: pitch
geninlet.digest: Frequency Modulation @default 0. FM signal in Pitch units. This FMs the inlet 1 cutoff value if selected. This inlet is ignored if @mode == 0

geninlet.name: hz
geninlet.digest: Frequency Modulation @default 0. FM signal in Hz units. This FMs the inlet 1 cutoff value if selected. This operates regardless of the @mode attribute.

attribute.name: cliplimit
attribute.description: If on (1), the frequency output is limited as a product of the @high attribute and samplerate; this can be useful for oscillators that are bandlimited only to a certain frequency. If off (0), frequency output is limited to samplerate * 0.5.

attribute.name: high
attribute.description: A multiplier of samplerate, 0..0.5, frequency output is high clipped to this if @cliplimit == 1

attribute.name: low
attribute.description: In Hz, the frequency output is low clipped to this value (unless the result of the @high calculation is lower).

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: If mode == 1, inlet 1 is required to be in Pitch values (the default). If mode == 0, inlet 1 is required to be in Hz values and inlet 2 (pitch) is ignored.

attribute.name: outnomod
attribute.description: If on (1), the abstraction computes and outputs an additional frequency output (outlet 2) which is derived from the outlet 1 frequency but with no modulation applied. default off (0). This can be very useful for downstream processing and is used in e.g. 'evi_squine_simple.gendsp'.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing time in ms of the main cutoff frequency. By default this is off (0.). Turn off if directly modulating inlet 1 (e.g. via an envelope / LFO). If > 0., the curoff is smoothed using a smoother chosen by the @smoothtype attribute. If selected, smoothing takes place before the pitch and/or frequency modulation signals. Affects both outlet 1 and outlet 2

attribute.name: smoothtype
attribute.description: Select the type of smoother used to smooth the main cutoff frequency (before FM) if the @smooth attribute is > 0. 0=evi_cfsmooth (default), 1=evi_logsmooth, 2=evi_line, 3=evi_sline, 4=evi_lagsmooth.

attribute.name: tuning
attribute.description: The base cutoff tuning (of embedded evi_mtofapprox) in Hz, default 440 Hz. This affects the Pitch modulation only, if @mode == 1.
